# Mingalar Edu

> Study abroad guidance for Myanmar students considering China, Europe (Spain, Switzerland, Germany) and Korea.

## Languages
- [English](https://mingalaredu.com/en/)
- [Myanmar edition](https://mingalaredu.com/my/): English content while Burmese translation is in preparation.

## Destinations
- [China](https://mingalaredu.com/en/study-in-china/)
- [Europe](https://mingalaredu.com/en/study-in-europe/)
- [Korea](https://mingalaredu.com/en/study-in-korea/)
